findings.actual: KILL exists only when leader itself stays alive past wait(timeout=5). If leader exited or dies before remaining descendant, epilogue sends only TERM; no group KILL/escalation follows.
findings.expected: TERM then bounded grace then KILL remaining own process group irrespective of leader exit
findings.minimal_fix: Track/escalate own session/process group independently of leader proc.poll/wait and verify descendant cleanup with <=5sec Python unit.
